messages:
Evan: Received invoice HC-420 for $21,000 from Helix Compute but AP can't auto-match to PO. Invoice lists currency as EUR even though PO was USD. Vendor is pushing for payment.
AP Bot: Invoice HC-420 scanned. Status: Currency mismatch with PO RWD-2024-303. Manual review required.
Priya: I see PO RWD-2024-303 in Coupa for $21,000 USD. Helix appears to have mistakenly issued EUR invoice. @Nora can you confirm if we have a signed FX clause in the contract?
Nora: Contract code HEL-POW-01 lists USD billing. No FX clause. We need corrected invoice in USD or a written confirmation to accept EUR and note FX rate.
Vendor Helix: Apologies, that was our billing system defaulting to EUR. We can reissue HC-420 in USD or provide a USD equivalent credit memo. Will send corrected invoice by EOD.
Evan: Thanks. Also, approver on the PO is Mark P. who is out this week. Who can approve payment if invoice arrives before his return?
Priya: Finance policy allows delegate approvals. Mark's delegate is @Asha; she can approve up to $25k. Add Asha to the approval chain.
AP Bot: PO RWD-2024-303 updated with delegate approver Asha. Ticket FIN-6021 created for this invoice.
Accounting: Note for month-end close: if vendor insists on EUR we need to book exchange loss/gain. Prefer corrected USD invoice to avoid FX revaluation.
Nora: Once corrected invoice attached I'll validate line items (there's also a one-off connectivity surcharge of $750 that isn't in SOW). Evan please confirm with vendor whether surcharge is valid.
Evan: Asked Helix to confirm surcharge. They replied: "Connectivity surcharge is a temporary passthrough for our new peering; contract doesn't cover it so we'll remove it and reissue."
AP Bot: Invoice HC-420 status: Pending vendor correction -> Ready for approval (awaiting corrected invoice).
Priya: I'll approve as soon as corrected USD invoice attached and PO lines match.
Evan: Marking FIN-6021 as HIGH priority for month-end. Will close thread when payment scheduled.
